display.purpose: The page question; 1.7rem under 480px, max 42ch, balanced.

headline.purpose: The three headline numbers, tabular numerals.

verdict.purpose: Plain-language statistical result, max 46ch, bold runs at 800.

note.purpose: Explanations and caveats, muted, max 68ch; small notes never below 0.82rem.

label.purpose: Stat labels and tab labels (tabs 1rem, 800 when selected).

station-name.purpose: Ward or channel names on the transit line, one aligned signage column.

station-stop.purpose: Day labels left of the line; red at the slowest terminus.

shadows.name: bullet-ring
shadows.purpose: Spread ring that draws the header's route-bullet mark. A stroke, not elevation; the system has no drop shadows.

motion.name: station-slide
motion.purpose: Names and stations slide from their previous stop (translateY(var(--dy))) on category change. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.css: .ds-strip { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 380px; height: auto; overflow: visible; } .ds-line { stroke: #0057A8; stroke-width: 10; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-stop { font: 800 14px Overpass, sans-serif; fill: #1B1F24; } .ds-stop--slow { fill: #D52B1E; } .ds-name { font: 500 15px Overpass, sans-serif; fill: #1B1F24; } .ds-move { animation: ds-slide 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; --dy: 24px; } @keyframes ds-slide { from { transform: translateY(var(--dy, 0px)); } to { transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-move { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page reads like the line map above the doors of an Edmonton LRT car: a white ground, a near-black header bar, thick round-capped blue line, white station cores inside coloured rings, and route-bullet markers. The metaphor is functional, not decorative. Response times are stops on a line; ties are interchanges; the fastest and slowest ends are the termini, and only they get their own colours.

Density is calm and editorial: one finding per block, generous whitespace, notes in muted ink at a readable measure. Everything is set in one self-hosted family, Overpass, whose Highway Gothic lineage carries the signage voice. Charts that are not transit lines (categories, seasonality, map) share the palette and type but not the line metaphor.

The world rejects the default KPI-card-plus-chart-grid dashboard: no boxed metric cards, no shadowed tiles, no Streamlit chrome (toolbar, decoration stripe and default header are hidden).
keyCharacteristics: Colour is a data role, never decoration.
One type family, Overpass, with tabular numerals on every figure.
Round geometry: rings, pills, round line caps, route bullets.
Flat white ground; hairlines, not shadows, separate content.
One signature motion: stations slide to their new stop.

rules.name: The Terminus Rule
rules.body: Green means fastest and red means slowest, and nothing else. A line with one stop uses blue at both ends. Never use green or red as a category colour.

rules.name: The Series Order Rule
rules.body: Categorical charts draw from blue, amber, violet, slate, in that order.

rules.name: The Blue Bullet Rule
rules.body: Every route bullet is Route Blue; bullets mark structure, not data values.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Overpass everywhere, including Plotly figures (14px, hover labels 13px). No second face.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px Hairline rule or whitespace, never a raised surface.

dos: Do reserve Express Green for the fastest and Terminus Red for the slowest, including on continuous fast-to-slow scales.
Do colour chart categories in the order blue, amber, violet, slate.
Do draw every route bullet in Route Blue: an outline ring for unselected, filled for selected.
Do set every figure in Overpass with tabular numerals.
Do keep notes at 0.82rem (about 13px) or larger, including on phones.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` for the station slide.
donts: Don't use green or red as a series or category colour.
Don't put headline numbers or charts in boxed, shadowed KPI cards.
Don't introduce a second typeface or fall back to a system display face.
Don't show Streamlit's default toolbar, decoration stripe or header.
Don't render the transit line with `st.html`; it strips inline SVG.
